Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within bwprtscr.exe, which is accessed through the 0x2711 IOCTL in the webvrpcs process. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this functionality to execute code under the context of Administrator. Advantech has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
